children: value of the transaction pegged at Rs 1.13 lakh per sq ft Kailash Babar Mumbai: Dinesh Thakkar, founder and CMD of financial services and stockbroking firm Angel One, has inked an agreement to purchase an entire luxury residential tower in Mumbai's Juhu locality for over 711 crore, said persons with direct knowledge of the development.

This is among the largest single residential transactions in the country and the biggest this year anywhere, underscoring continued demand for ultra-luxury homes in Mumbai's established high-value residential markets. The residence comprises an entire G+7 storey tower on Juhu Tara Road with a RERA carpet area of 63,000 sq ft.

This puts the value of the transaction at around 1.13 lakh per sq ft, a new record for residential properties in Juhu. The agreement for the transaction was inked last week. The transaction gives Thakkar ownership of the entire tower. The ultra-luxury project is part of a five-tower development spread over 2 acres of land with 50 residences and has an estimated gross development value (GDV) of over 3,000 crore.

This project, scheduled to be completed by December 2031 is being executed by Embassy Developments under a development management model. Demand for luxury and ultra-luxury housing in Mumbai has remained resilient, with high-net-worth individuals and business promoters continuing to seek large-format residences in established premium neighbourhoods.

The segment has also seen a rise in high-value transactions as buyers increasingly seek larger homes, privacy and exclusivity, particularly in locations such as Juhu, Bandra and Worli. Limited availability of sizeable residential inventory in these established markets has further supported values at the top end of the housing market. Juhu has emerged as one of Mumbai's prominent ultra-luxury residential markets, with demand concentrated around large-format residences offering privacy, larger floor plates and premium amenities.

title: Angel One's Founder to Buy 711-cr Hsg Tower in Mumbai
